messages:
tanya: quick sync — can we confirm owners for tracing hooks vs retention backfill? planning handoff to SRE next Tue. blocking deps on infra-metrics and the db migration. @sam @li any updates?
sam: tracing hooks are wired in staging, still need the schema change merged (PR posted). I can run a smoke canary once schema is approved. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/341
li: PR is up, tests failing on one integration. small stack: ```ERROR: kv_cache not found during hook init``` — looks infra-related. pinging @michael for schema review and @infra-bot for infra snapshot.
infra-bot: deploy blocked — awaiting task "db-migration-2026" (blocking: true). current status: waiting-on-ops.
michael: I can take the schema review today, will add comments on the PR. FYI retention backfill is currently owned by priya-ops team; I can help craft the canary plan and rollback steps.
priya: confirming: priya-ops owns the backfill. target low-traffic window is Thu night. we need a snapshot from infra and a runbook with throttles. @infra-bot can you tag a snapshot for Thursday?
infra-bot: snapshot tagged: snapshot-2026-03-18-02. To trigger backfill run: `./run_backfill --snapshot snapshot-2026-03-18-02 --target retention-days=90 --throttle 200r/s`
tanya: action items recap: michael -> review schema PR today; li -> address flaky integration (or escalate to flaky-team); priya -> schedule backfill with infra snapshot + runbook; sam -> prep canary dashboards (latency p95, error-rate, KV hits). I'll add owners to the roadmap doc and set the handoff meeting. :white_check_mark:
michael: on it, will push comments before EOD. :eyes:
li: reassigning flaky-test to flaky-team, will follow up and post a patch. :thumbsup:
sam: dashboard draft posted: https://docs.redwood-inference/internal/observability/dashboards/console-hooks — set alerts for >2% error or p95 increase >50ms. please review and mention any missing metrics.
tanya: perfect — I'll loop in SRE for Tue handoff and update milestone card. thanks everyone, keeping this thread for async updates.
